flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Report/{lists/ReportListRIP.tsx,component/ReportGridBase.tsx} (RIP grid without checkbox), components/datagrid/Datagrid.tsx (component supports checkbox but the RIP screen does not use it), ocmsadminapi workflows/reports/system/rip/RipReportController (search and xlsx export), ocmsadminprivateapi framework/controllers/ToppanUnifiedController (generate letters without an ID list). No ID selection and no per-selected-ID letter generation
note: The story asks the officer to select IDs from the result on screen so letters are generated only for the selected IDs. The RIP screen only shows a grid with Search/Export buttons (xlsx of all rows); there is no select/checkbox column and no generate-letter action. The existing letter generation (Toppan) runs per stage for all notices, without an ID list. demo_remark 'RIP'. Related ticket: OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT) about the manual letter generation trigger, not ID selection
recommendation: Do not claim. Only the RIP result display exists; ID selection and letter generation for selected IDs do not exist

steps.step: The results are displayed on screen
steps.detail: Same as OCMS14.14 step 1: the result shows in the RIP screen grid (ReportListRIP.tsx:74-76; index.tsx:85-88), but its content is the furnished hirer/driver report, not an ownership enquiry result (a generic page, not the one the story names).

steps.step: The officer selects the IDs for which letters will be generated
steps.detail: Datagrid supports a checkbox prop (Datagrid.tsx:122), but ReportListRIP.tsx does not use it (0 occurrences of checkbox/select in the file) and ReportGridBase.tsx:19-32 just passes props without a checkbox. There is no ID selection column or state on the RIP screen; the only actions are Search and Export (ReportSlot.tsx:149-151).

steps.step: Letters are generated only for the selected IDs
steps.detail: The RIP endpoints are only search (RipReportController.java:29) and xlsx export (:66); there is no generate-letter endpoint. The existing letter generation is POST /toppan/generate-letters without parameters, 'all stages' (ToppanUnifiedController.java:34-40), with no ID list and no knowledge of RIP. The executeJob() call in the scheduler is commented out (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/schedulers/ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.java:118), so letters only run through the manual trigger.
